## 3. Basis note (for analysts who ask why the number moved)

Apple's FY2024 consolidated statement of operations presents Services net sales net of amounts collected on behalf of third parties. In the FY2024 filing cycle those pass-through amounts totaled $38,135M and were presented gross in the October 2024 earnings materials; the conformed filing presentation reports them net, with a matching reduction to cost of sales. **Gross margin dollars, operating income, net income, and EPS are identical under both presentations** — which is why this registry's other locked FY2024 values are unchanged and remain consistent with figures you may have verified independently.

Reconciliation: $352,900M (net, reported) + $38,135M (pass-through, not Company revenue) = $391,035M (gross billings, not a GAAP revenue measure).

Segment lines on the net basis reconcile to $352,900M: Americas $166,100M, Europe $101,300M, Greater China $66,900M, Japan $25,000M, Rest of Asia Pacific $31,700M (segment figures include intra-segment Services on the net basis).
